name: snakeskin_veil_hexproof_ends_with_the_turn
notes: M3 mapper. Printed: 'Put a +1/+1 counter on target creature you control. It gains hexproof until end of turn.' Seat 0 casts Snakeskin Veil on its 2/2 (now 3/3 with the counter). The turn ends and the hexproof with it; then the opponent's Scorching Dragonfire can target the creature: 3 damage kill it and it is exiled instead (Dragonfire's own replacement).
